notes.title: Carol has been sidetracked by Hades 2, Onirism 1.0 on Oct 2nd!
notes.notes:
So as most of you will be well aware of by now, Hades 2 is coming out of Early Access on the same day we planned to do so. This means we’re going to have to shift release to be a week later on October 2nd to avoid being undoubtedly buried by a truly amazing title. 

The good news is that this gives us even more time to ensure Onirism 1.0 is the best it possibly can be, so stay tuned for more info on what 1.0 will contain!

And finally, Congratulations on an awesome game Supergiant, we’ll all be playing!

~Crimson Tales & Shoreline Games

notes.title: Onirism Launches into 1.0 on September 25th!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LHcOfSbuDIM;full][/previewyoutube]

At last, it’s that time. After 6 long years we’ve finally made it to the last milestone for our vision to come to life. 

On September 25th, 2025, we’ll be releasing the 1.0 update for our beloved project that will see the story come to a close. 

That’s right, Onirism 1.0 is right around the corner!

We started this journey long ago and are unbelievably excited to share with everyone what will be coming in 1.0. From amazing new zones to explore, new monsters, new bosses, dozens of gadgets & weapons, and so much more, the thrilling conclusion to Carol’s story will be one action packed adventure.

We’ll have a full list of what’s to come in the coming weeks but until then, enjoy these exclusive renders from some of our favourite areas.

	Map System:

- Added the map system (using tab or select on controller) the player now have access to a map of the area, that slowly get revealed the more you explore.
- Added Objectives markers to the new map system along with a quest log, to keep track of your current objectives.
- Added Various icons for points of interest for the new map system.
- Added current level completion % (Story, secrets, items discovered etc)

- The nightmare world is now a twisted mirror version of the original level
- The nightmare atmosphere will now raise a new "fear" bar wich will result in a gameover if it reach the current HP threshold
- Added lost plushies in the nightmare that generate bubbles of light, protecting Carol from the atmosphere and bringing down the fear bar
- Nightmare enemies no longer produce nightmare fuel after being defeated, but to compensate they have higher health and now raise the fear bar when they hit the player

- Added the Buzzard plane
- Added Royal hovercraft
- "Mech" types are now able to jump
- Ponies are now able to jump

- Completly overhauled the camera systems, heavily reducing issues related to camera

Hey everyone !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/f61f0ea2786e5799659d486ded171f743c4ae3ed.png[/img]

Big update incoming ! there is a LOTS of changes in this one, so let's begin !

NEW ADVENTURE AREA: THE WINDY MEADOWS !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/a504023134648e5c1db0fd1c9b32c845177ec45d.png[/img]

Wait, what ? What is this ? Where is my candy kingdom ? You lied to us !
The Windy meadows is a new area taking place between the Inferno Valley and Shining Treetops, we felt that early game Onirism lacked the gameplay variety of later levels, and we wanted to break up the linearity a little bit with an open vehicle level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/8fb1f824b3d05b0542fcacef6e13de4009f5b290.jpg[/img]
The meadows are a pretty vast level where you can use vehicles to traverse quickly, but there is also a lot of things to discover ! And plenty of new enemies to shoot !

Hey everyone !

First of all, i need to answer some questions some of you might have.
Why did it take so much time to release this update ?

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/3948e1acfcb01f7b00cbc675db1e4749308a410d.png[/img]

Here it is, finaly, the big story update !
Welcome to Al-Hibdae, the city of science, magic and knowledge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/126d4e1909aa23f2f0855b2f524bb7309f7cd45f.png[/img]

Play through the end of chapter 5 and chapter 6: A thousand and one mischiefs !

But to get to the city, Carol will have to ride the Clockwork Express !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/90a0e65ff95e7f6ad7d62d1871e2bbfcb9116ac8.png[/img]

We have decided this time to not put new weapons, gadgets and outfits in the patchnote, to leave it as a surprise for players, as we think it's more fun this way !


GAMEPLAY CHANGES:

Now let's get into the big gameplay changes.

- Gadgets and Elixirs have been completly overhauled.
We felt like players were not using gadgets and elixirs to their full potential, and that they felt limited as they had a ressource to take care of, often leading to players waiting for the "right time" to use them, but never actually using them.

-Gadgets work now like abilities:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/e731d2da473cfdc7c44230c46825069f1d15a818.png[/img]

-Carol can now only carry two gadgets, but both are bound to their own input now ( Q and E for Qwerty keyboards, LB and RB for controllers, use key have been moved to F by default, and weapon swap to the Dpad on controllers.)
-Imagination is gone, now gadgets work on cooldowns, some gadgets having multiple uses
-All gadgets have been adjusted to feel more impactful, into more powerful versions of themselves
-Mana wells and Creafizz machines have been removed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/e276a86c1c0f18b31d794abd59b9bc313c58a7c5.png[/img]

-Imagination shards have been turned into hourglasses that reduce cooldown when picked up
-Imagination expension are now STAMINA EXPENSIONS ! (They all respawned, so you have to find them in levels again)

-Elixirs now have their own slot (R by default, X on controller)
-A lot of elixirs have been merged into shorter, but way more powerful buffs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/b3b20d74517cd8b554203f97442cb9d7b487fb7c.png[/img]
-Carol now have her own magic canteen to drink elixirs from.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/0d260b5db2525403ef1c936f30042213bc756e0c.png[/img]
-After drinking an elixir, you have to charge it up again over time, or by dealing damage to enemies.
-Ragg's no longer sell elixirs, and they are gone from the toybox
-random elixirs machine have been removed from the adventure
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/8893ca83d4d909a9c4c797c6bc816903848b45f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/f8dae88a38cbf02e600566e76a52878591e3993e.png[/img]
-New elixir machine have remplaced them ! Those new machines are free, and let you pick the one you want out of 3 random elixirs, and automaticly fill it
-the New elixir machines have been added to Hunt maps
-Random elixir machines are still available in Tales maps, and Elixirs require more damage to charge after each wave (to balance the power gain the player get)

-Toybox Rework !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/83f892a3525a8dc7a69702a9fe4753a2d90845dc.jpg[/img]
-Picked up weapons and gadgets are now automaticly unlocked in the toybox, no need to deposit them
-duplicates have been removed
-Weapons and gadgets abandonned in world are no longer lost
-Weapons and gadgets are now ordered by type in the toybox
-Ragg's no longer sell you items you already own

Misc changes:

The hairdryer got a new model, along with new visual effects
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/79de7bccff3548d0da29139db7a3abbea5600fcd.png[/img]
-the hairdryer can no longer headshot, but charge damage was increased to 50
-Melee charge damage have been increased to 60, and spin attack damage to 80
-New model for the Garnet revolver
-New model for the winchesters
-You are now able to go prone and dive in first person mode
-Improved first person animations
-Added extra animations for gadgets in first person
-Some outfits have extra hair physics on them (skater, for exemple)
-this won't be visible to the players, but we have made a new pooling system for projectiles, wich should increase the game performance quite a bit during fights.
-Fixed many many bugs !


There it is ! The big update ! We hope you will all enjoy it !

See you next update !

The FROST & RUST update !

- Carol and Multiplayer characters now have 8 ways diagonal run animations, meaning running diagonaly feels a lot more natural now !

- Wich means Carol is now able to fire any guns while dodging, including Slides, pixie dash and prone rolls

The next part of the adventure is available !

Rage full on war on the Corporation, with the help of Narrs and friends !

Take the Factory from the Corporation and secure the victory for the Plush Alliance !

The Rusty Canyon is a gigantic level, from mineshafts to the big canyon panoramas that require giant dandelions to travel, passing by rivers with steamboats and Daisy's town, this new level should take players quite a bit to fully explore !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/b43b29f80f2cfecff1a25d1adf03ec02a00b5b5f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/71177c24ab103aaab942ac8f3242b406aed02886.jpg[/img]

- Events have been renamed to Tales and are located in ARCADE
- Coop adventure is located in the ADVENTURE sub menu, and player count has been increased to 4

- New DIFFICULTY MODES !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/ad315358b9c40406890462cf9a3827a047cd2d0e.jpg[/img]

- Mommy, i'm sleepy (very easy)
- Nap time (easy)
- Wide awake (normal, current difficulty)
- Restless (hard)
- Insomniac (very hard)

Survival mode has been remplaced by a brand new mode, the HUNT !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/6ebb0595b89b0f76504d8421464afa696f81b21b.png[/img]

Welcome to Hunt ! The Goal of this mode is to survive multiple wave of enemies and get the higher score ! The more enemies you eliminate in a row the more points you get ! All survival maps have been reworked for hunt mode.

You will always start with the same equipment in every map of Hunt.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/930b7a4b66c374920962ad06dc10b8e215bd004c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/3ab45288dad61580aa61fac58ecc0fdea97681af.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/39440914318a4e95afff3da6c4c819866cd6f404.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/de3338292e141034edaa653d4f04b68c43d33818.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/fb6bfcb6aad247f01a11e62ef4508ae5409b6f68.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/a9d898e83bacc06ed2f88632278251188c8b3bbf.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/d58e0ca17d8831af4861ee35f64a722f67af112a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/50f12fa90d2c542b2c5d0bd3a29008d1f7e35918.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/0f13f141d5e6fc1409fa1c4ef919ff91f57c7031.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/0b8fa766dcfc144d1bdb07caa90944e8514cd381.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/3af1287391de868aa0b295ba57cd1a565369c17d.jpg[/img]

Inbetween waves, use these machine to upgrade your Toys, abilities, stats and gadgets !

New abilities:
- Speed Demon: When eliminating an enemy, you gain speed that gradualy decay, the more enemies you eliminate in a row, the faster you will go
- Vampiress: Gain health on eliminations
- Hard Looter: Chance to get your Ammo back on eliminations

New Gadgets:
- Bouncy bombs: Bombs that bounce around
- Pico Hammer: fast hammers that can be thrown very quickly
- Electrocanon: an arm canon that shoot an electrical orb capable of stunning enemies
- Rocket Punch: it's a rocket punch. what else ?
- Eggshield: this shield will prevent enemies from shooting at you while active


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/d1781169ff8ccbe4294ce9aebf66b8f234d04408.jpg[/img]

This is a Bot Spawner, you can activate it during the wave to spawn robots that will award cash ! Use these smartly, as they can be used to keep your combo up !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/f18e3077bfb49c7a68b9266bb8c33ecba5631bf7.jpg[/img]

Meet the Maxcot ! He can spawn during waves randomly. Shoot him, he got a lot of pearls in his pockets

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/432543cf51359777e117f897d66d4f2620a7be1c.png[/img]

Here come the Corporation specialists ! They are units with special abilities that can spawn during waves to mess with the player, and try to put a stop to the match

- The Gunner ( HP: 300 / Shield: 300)
Equipped with a minigun, keep your distances and keep shooting to bring down his massive Hp pool, thanksfully he's pretty slow.

- The Sniper ( HP: 150 / Shield: 0)
He's the type to stay at a distance and deal massive damage with his rifle, but be careful as he can bring out a machinegun for close range combat ! He also have traps that he might put around the field, so be careful where you step.

- The Cloaker ( HP: 120 / Shield: 0)
She's the specialist with the least HP, To bad you can't see her. If you feel that she is close by, try to damage her to disable her cloak, otherwise she will use a barrage of melee attacks to quickly bring your health down, or blind you with flashbangs.

- The Engineer ( HP: 150 / Shield: 50)
If you see her, put her to sleep as soon as possible, otherwise she will start building sentry gun all over the map. She can also use forcefields to block your shots, and her welder deals massive damage at close range.

- The Grappler ( HP: 150 / Shield: 200)
The grappler is a specialist that focus on moving fast and bringing the player to her using her grapple arm to do a big uppercut. She can also charge at the player to push them back or use a shotgun attack.

- The Crusader ( HP: 250/ Shield: 0)
A dueling specialist, deal with the enemies around him first as he's going to need your full attention.
Quick to dodge, time your attacks perfectly otherwise you are going to be in trouble

The Specialists will now also appear in the adventure in Corporation controlled areas, so be careful
the Corporation special forces also got reworked to a more sci fi design.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/0d982bdd618f9bf4e46036f0511ecdb7b9b389e3.png[/img]


- NEW HUNT MAP : Rookie's Dome (Tutorial map for hunt mode)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/ef34a4d00318cc1bb4d5145ca3f20129c8db6a9c.png[/img]

- NEW HUNT MAP : Neptunia's Marina

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/a471c41f8a5540eb19161b3c89d4874351c3df9e.png[/img]

___________________________________________________________________

Adventure areas rework : The Shining Treetops and The Tortibobble Swamps have been fully reworked !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/6a764476ad416a835f4d912882658314acc3cdc5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/3afd54bfbd1e473a5d69e181aec69f48065f0ec7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/ba362b14e22acc2c75842d336dbaedf68e2ee617.png[/img]

- Since the Arenas in Treetops changed, Players that already went past this point can go back to Trigger them again
- The Hive Totem was altered, it can now shoot bombs that roll around the floor, and no longer spawn Bees, it can activate a green laser grid instead
- Treetops have a new enemy type: The Floria Warrior

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/f5508c72c15eedb80497dced500bf8e37e465b1f.jpg[/img]

Carol's Pyjamas and umbrella have been updated to better looking models !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/48778b935456564bdbd799f604e3167a6aa79056.png[/img]

- Carol had many of her animations improved, mainly the running, gadget throwing, and counter attack animations, and also have new animations when using her umbrella.

- The Pause menu was reworked to match the new Main Menu style, and you can now access the settings ingame !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/4f083be467758004ddc65970d5e8934ef9132403.jpg[/img]

- We added Aim assist in the settings so players who had trouble aiming can enjoy the game more !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/032ac843e692b5bf49b80fee765f3a4a3655f17b.jpg[/img]

- V-Sync was added in the Video settings
- FPS Limiter was added in the Video settings
- Weapons now reload and cool down when they are put away, so they can be ready when needed
- When buying weapons or gadgets from the Shop when your inventory is full, the remplaced item will be automaticly sent to the toybox
- Added Camera shake to impactful hits and explosions
- Volcano had some changes to

That's pretty much it ! I probably forgot a lot of things but it was hard to keep track of everything we did this time, sorry it took so long but we cleaned a lot of the game in this update.
Next updates will come much faster now, we have plenty planned !
We sincerly hope you enjoy this update, we worked very hard on it.

Love from the devs ~

notes.title: Onirism Sneaky Update !
notes.notes:
Onirism early access 1.7.1 update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34865956/b8296e514d777922b192084fd98b249a712667f9.png[/img]

Hi everyone ! We are releasing a "small" update this week as we want feedback !
We have introduced a new system to the game: Carol is now able to sneak around enemies by pressing left control (Right stick button on controllers) by default
While crouching, you will see a detection bar appear that fills up while you are in an enemy field of view, once completly filled up, you are detected.
You can still sprint, roll, use gadgets and melee while sneaking, but jumping or aiming will break the stealth.
